en.headline: Hong Kong Fashion Fest returns from 1 to 14 September
en.dek: The government-backed third edition will stage eight flagship programmes across the city, with public exhibitions free of charge.
body: The third Hong Kong Fashion Fest will run from 1 to 14 September, presented by the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region Government and spearheaded by the Cultural and Creative Industries Development Agency of the Culture, Sports and Tourism Bureau. Organisers said the two-week programme will bring together more than 300 local and international design entities.

In collaboration with six industry organisations, the fest will present eight flagship programmes. They include the opening couture programme VIRTUOSE: The Artistry of Couture 2026; the citywide pop-up Wear's HK, which the Clothing Industry Training Authority said will place 20 Hong Kong designer brands in six districts from 1 to 14 September; and CENTRESTAGE, the Hong Kong Trade Development Council's fashion showcase and trade platform, at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre from 2 to 5 September.

Fashion Summit (Hong Kong) 2026, organised by the Clothing Industry Training Authority, is scheduled for 3 September at the Hong Kong Palace Museum under the theme Code the Fashion Forward, with a related exhibition of sustainable apparel by 20 local brands at the Common Arcade, 1/F, Jardine House, Central, from 1 to 14 September. Future Threads: Menswear's New Waves Between Italy and Hong Kong, organised by the Hong Kong Design Centre with Italy's Camera Nazionale della Moda Italiana, runs from 2 to 13 September at Fashion Walk in Causeway Bay.

The organisers said admission to all public exhibitions in this edition is free. Details of individual programmes are listed on the official site hongkongfashionfest.com. The enquiry number given by the Hong Kong Tourism Board listing is 2594 5749.

zh.headline: 第三屆香港時裝蕃九月1日至14日舉行
zh.dek: 政府主辦的時裝蕃將推出八大旗艦節目，公眾展覽免費入場，涉及西九、會展及市區快閃店。
body: 第三屆香港時裝蕃將於9月1日至14日舉行，由香港特區政府主辦，文化體育及旅遊局文創產業發展處策劃及贊助。主辦單位稱，為期兩週的活動將聚集超300個本地及國際設計單位。
時裝蕃與六個業界組織合作，推出八大旗艦節目，包括開幕節目「VIRTUOSE：高級定製的藝術…2026」、製衣業訓練局主辦的全城快閃「Wear's HK」（9月1日至14日，20個香港設計品牌進駐六個地段），以及香港貿發局主辦的香港國際時尚匯展CENTRESTAGE（9月2日至5日，香港會議展覽中心）。
製衣業訓練局主辦的時裝峰會（香港）2026定於9月3日假香港故宮文化博物館舉行，主題為「Code the Fashion Forward」；同期將於中環怡和大廈一樓Common Arcade展出20個本地品牌的可持續服裝，展期9月1日至14日。香港設計中心主辦、意大利國家時裝商會合作的「共織新意：意大利與香港男裝新浪潮」則於9月2日至13日在銅鑼灣Fashion Walk舉行。
主辦單位表示，本屆所有公眾展覽免費入場。各節目詳情見官網hongkongfashionfest.com。香港旅遊發展局活動頁列出查詢電話2594 5749。
